title: Baker Mayfield: Bears barked out the Buccaneers' cadence, causing a false start

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Baker Mayfield: Bears barked out the Buccaneers' cadence, causing a false start
sources.description: The Buccaneers were flagged for five false starts on Sunday night, and quarterback Baker Mayfield said at least one of them was caused by an illegal tactic by the Bears.
